He was educated at King Edward VI School, Stratford-upon-Avon and the University of Oxford. Shakespeare died in Stratford-upon-Avon. He is a citizen of the Kingdom of England and was married to Anne Hathaway, Philip IV of France, and Maria Amalia of Naples and Sicily.
